facts.statement: The protein EIF4A3 attaches to the circular RNA circ_0000285 and causes its levels to rise.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: High glucose conditions caused both EIF4A3 and circ_0000285 to increase in kidney podocyte cells.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: High glucose exposure stopped cell growth and increased cell death, inflammation, and oxidative stress in the studied cells.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Reducing the amount of EIF4A3 partially fixed the problems caused by high glucose in the cells.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The protein Cyclin F attaches to EIF4A3 and helps the cell break it down.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: Adding extra Cyclin F helped heal kidney damage, lowered inflammation and oxidative stress, and improved kidney function in both living animals and cells.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The amount of Cyclin F dropped in kidney podocyte cells when they were exposed to high glucose.
facts.subject: cells_or_tissue

facts.statement: The authors suggest that the Cyclin F pathway could be a future target for treating diabetic kidney disease.
